test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
To ensure your safety at the workplace, which of the following should be ensured?

1. All necessary protective clothing and equipment are used.

2. The necessary training and instructions for performing tasks safely have been received.
solution:
The correct answer is __Both statements 1 and 2.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To ensure safety at the workplace__, the following practices are essential:
 
• Employees must use all necessary protective clothing and equipment to minimize risks.
 
• Providing necessary training and instructions ensures that tasks are performed safely and effectively.
 
• These measures reduce the likelihood of workplace accidents and injuries.
 
• Both components are essential for fostering a safe and productive work environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Workplace Safety Guidelines:**

 
 
• Employers are responsible for providing adequate safety measures in accordance with industry standards.
 
• Employees should report hazards or unsafe practices to supervisors immediately.
 
 
 
• **Protective Equipment:**
 
 
• Examples include helmets, gloves, goggles, and safety shoes.
 
• Regular checks and maintenance of equipment are essential for effectiveness.
 
 
 
• **Training Programs:**
 
 
• Training on emergency procedures, equipment handling, and risk management is crucial.
 
• Periodic refresher courses help in reinforcing safe work practices.
